ei.title: From Elite to Mass Higher Education
ei.subject: 9월_2024 고1 모의고사
ei.lesson: From Elite to Mass Higher Education

fullPassage:
Higher education has grown from an elite to a mass system across the world. In Europe and the USA, increased rates of participation occurred in the decades after the Second World War. Between 2000 and 2014, rates of participation in higher education almost doubled from 19% to 34% across the world among the members of the population in the school-leaving age category (typically 18-23). The dramatic expansion of higher education has been marked by a wider range of institutions of higher learning and a more diverse demographic of students.

Changes from an elite system to a mass higher education system are associated with political needs to build a specialised workforce for the economy. In theory, the expansion of higher education to develop a highly skilled workforce should diminish the role of examinations in the selection and control of students, initiating approaches to assessment which block lifelong learning: assessment for learning and a focus on feedback for development. In reality, socio-political changes to expand higher education have set up a 'field of contradictions' for assessment in higher education. Mass higher education requires efficient approaches to assessment, such as examinations and multiple-choice quizzes, with minimalist, impersonal, or standardised feedback, often causing students to focus more on grades than feedback. In contrast, the relatively small numbers of students in elite systems in the past allowed for closer relationships between students and their teachers, with formative feedback shaping the minds, academic skills, and even the characters of students.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) elite=소수 정예의 (B) doubled=두 배가 되었다 (C) diverse=다양한
det.analysis:
✅ ① elite — doubled — diverse: 원문 일치. 고등교육이 '소수 정예(elite)'에서 대중 체제로 바뀌고, 참여율이 '두 배가 되었으며(doubled)', 학생 구성이 더 '다양(diverse)'해졌다는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
❌ ② modern — doubled — diverse: (A) modern(현대의)은 대중 체제와 대비되는 '엘리트'라는 맥락과 어긋남
❌ ③ elite — halved — diverse: (B) halved(반으로 줄었다)는 참여율이 '두 배가 되었다'는 맥락과 반대
❌ ④ elite — doubled — uniform: (C) uniform(획일적인)은 '더 다양해졌다'는 맥락과 반대
det.tip: an elite to a mass system / almost doubled / more diverse demographic

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) expansion=확대 (B) specialised=전문화된 (C) efficient=효율적인
det.analysis:
❌ ① decline — specialised — efficient: (A) decline(쇠퇴)은 고등교육의 '극적인 확대(expansion)'라는 맥락과 반대

❌ ③ expansion — general — efficient: (B) general(일반적인)은 '전문화된' 인력이라는 맥락과 어긋남
❌ ④ expansion — specialised — wasteful: (C) wasteful(낭비적인)은 '효율적' 평가라는 맥락과 반대

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

In reality, socio-political changes to expand higher education have set up a 'field of contradictions' for assessment in higher education. Mass higher education requires efficient approaches to assessment, such as examinations and multiple-choice quizzes, with minimalist, impersonal, or standardised feedback, often causing students to focus more on grades than feedback. In contrast, the relatively small numbers of students in elite systems in the past allowed for closer relationships between students and their teachers, with formative feedback shaping the minds, academic skills, and even the characters of students.
